hazards.location_in_image: Roadway center

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large red dumpster is placed on the narrow sidewalk, restricting pedestrian movement.
hazards.location_in_image: Left-center of the image on the sidewalk

hazards.name: Wide Roadway
hazards.description: The straight, relatively wide roadway lacks traffic calming, which can encourage higher vehicle speeds in a residential zone.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image, the travel lanes.

hazards.name: Potential for High Vehicle Speeds
hazards.description: The wide, straight roadway with clear lane markings and no visible traffic calming measures may encourage vehicle speeds higher than appropriate for a residential street.
hazards.location_in_image: Center roadway

hazards.name: Poor sidewalk maintenance
hazards.description: Weeds and debris on the sidewalk create potential trip hazards and indicate a lack of upkeep.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the sidewalk in the foreground and midground.

hazards.name: Blank frontage
hazards.description: Boarded-up buildings on the left reduce natural surveillance and can make the pedestrian environment feel isolated.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street

hazards.name: Poor Sidewalk Surface
hazards.description: Cracks and vegetation growth in the sidewalk create minor tripping hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the walkway

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a wide roadway including travel lanes and wide shoulders, increasing exposure time to vehicle traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers and reduce crossing distance.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to reduce vehicle speeds on this straight residential stretch.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked, high-visibility crosswalks to provide designated and safer crossing locations.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at potential crossing points to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Vegetation
interventions.description: Planting street trees in a furniture zone or curb extension would provide a vertical element that naturally slows traffic and improves the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restricting parking near the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Speed Humps or Tables
interventions.description: Physical traffic calming measures to reduce vehicle speeds in a mixed-use area.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near potential crossing points or alleys to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Designated Trash Storage
interventions.description: Implement on-street corrals or dedicated zones for waste receptacles to keep the sidewalk clear for mobility.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or speed cushions to physically manage vehicle speeds on this long, straight residential stretch.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Add a consistent line of street trees in a furniture zone to provide shade and create a 'vertical wall' effect that naturally slows traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer or Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair cracked pavement and remove weeds to provide a smooth, accessible walking surface.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Expand the narrow sidewalk to improve accessibility and comfort for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Installing street trees or planters between the sidewalk and the curb would provide a physical and psychological buffer for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: If pedestrian volumes warrant, a marked midblock crossing with curb extensions would improve safety for residents crossing the street.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Install speed cushions to maintain low vehicle speeds appropriate for a residential environment.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Incorporate a planting strip or street trees where space permits to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the street.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement speed humps, speed cushions, or chicanes to physically reduce vehicle speeds along this residential stretch.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a safe legal crossing point.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add street trees on the left side to provide a vertical buffer and create a psychological narrowing effect for drivers.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalk markings and pedestrian crossing signage to designate safe crossing locations.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture or planting zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Widening
interventions.description: Repair cracked surfaces and widen the walkway where possible to improve accessibility and comfort.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to provide pedestrians with a head start before vehicles receive a green light, reducing conflicts with turning traffic.
